listen.title: A Day in My Digital Life
listen.text: Hi everyone! My name is Tarek, and I want to share my digital day with you. I always start my morning by checking my phone. I usually have three or four messages from my school friends. Sometimes, my cousin from Alexandria sends me funny pictures. At breakfast, I often use my tablet to search for news. My favorite app shows me interesting facts about animals and space. I never eat without looking at something on my screen. I know it's not a good habit! At school, we sometimes use the smartboard in our science class. Our teacher shows us amazing videos about planets and animals. I love watching them! We also use computers in our computer class twice a week. I'm learning to type faster. I can type 25 words per minute now! After school, I always do my homework first. I usually search for information on my laptop when I need help with my projects. My favorite website has lots of useful information for students. In the evening, I sometimes play online games with my friends. We usually play for one hour, then we stop. My parents always remind me to take breaks from the screen. Before bedtime, I often read ebooks on my tablet. I love adventure stories! But I always use the night mode so the screen doesn't hurt my eyes. I think technology is amazing, but I'm learning to use it wisely. What about you? How do you use technology in your day?

lessons.notes:
نقاط هامة على نص القراءة (A Day in Tarek's Digital Life):
1. Tarek's blog post is about his digital day. (يوم رقمي)
2. Tarek starts his morning by checking his phone. (فحص)
3. He usually has three or four messages from his friends every morning.
4. He uses his tablet to search for news at breakfast.
5. He looks at screens for a long time, and it's a bad habit. (شاشات)
6. At school, they sometimes use the smartboard in their science class. (السبورة الذكية)
7. He usually searches for information on his laptop for homework.
8. Before bedtime, he often reads ebooks on his tablet. (وقت النوم)
9. Tarek thinks technology is amazing, but he is learning to use it wisely. (بحكمة)
تنبيه: هذه الجمل تساعدك على كتابة فقرات إنشائية مثل: Technology in our life / Our digital day / The hybrid bus.

التعريفات (Study these definitions):
- screen (شاشة): a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown / the part of a device that shows images or text.
- ebook (كتاب إلكتروني): an electronic book you can read on a screen instead of on paper.
- laptop (حاسوب متنقل): a portable computer.
- night mode (وضع التشغيل الليلي): a darker screen setting to protect your eyes in low light.
- smartboard (سبورة ذكية): an interactive board used in classrooms for teaching lessons.
- website (موقع إلكتروني): a page on the internet that gives information or lets you do things online / a page or group of pages on the internet.
- digital (رقمي): using computer technology or electronic devices.
- apps (تطبيقات): programs used on phones, tablets or computers.
- search (يبحث): to look for information on the internet.
- tablet (كمبيوتر لوحي): a small portable touch-screen computer.

ملاحظات عامة على القراءة والاستماع:
1) online - offline
- online (adv) = عبر الإنترنت: Why don't you find information online?
- online (adj) + noun: Tarek likes playing online games.
- offline (adj) = غير متصل بالإنترنت: Ali is offline. He can't text me now.
2) instead - instead of
- instead (adv) = بدلًا من ذلك (تأتي في نهاية الجملة الثانية): He didn't use his tablet, he used his smartphone instead.
- instead of + noun / verb-ing = بدلًا من: Instead of doing his homework, he went to bed.
3) remind - remember
- remind (v) = يُذكّر شخصًا آخر: Can you remind Ali to bring his car?
- remember (v) = يتذكر من تلقاء نفسه: I remembered visiting Luxor last year.

- How do you start your morning? / I start my morning by checking my phone and getting ready for school.
- What do you do after school? / After school, I have a rest, do my homework, and use the internet for learning.

read.title: Sara's Digital Habits
read.text: Sara is a twelve-year-old student from Tanta. She loves technology, but she uses it carefully. Every morning, she checks the weather on her phone before she goes to school. At school, her teacher usually uses the smartboard to explain the lessons. After school, Sara does her homework and often searches for information on her laptop. She never plays online games before she finishes her homework. In the evening, she sometimes video calls her cousin in Alexandria. Before bedtime, she always turns on night mode and reads an ebook for twenty minutes. Sara's mother is happy because Sara takes breaks from the screen and plays outside with her friends on weekends.

listen.title: My Screen Time and The Hybrid Bus
listen.text: Hi, I'm Ayman, a 13-year-old student. I love my digital life! Every day, I spend about three hours on my smartphone. I use social media to chat with my friends and watch funny videos on the internet. It's fun but sometimes I spend too much time online. My mom says I need to reduce my screen time because it affects my sleep. She's right. Sometimes I feel tired in the morning. I also use my tablet for homework, like researching for projects. Digital devices are great, but I think we need to balance them with outdoor activities. Now let's listen to some news. Egypt has launched its first hybrid bus in Aswan. It runs on both electricity and diesel, helping reduce pollution and protect the environment. The bus was made by an Egyptian company and includes modern technology like smart navigation and quiet engines. It supports Egypt's Vision 2030 for clean, smart cities. Most parts of the bus are made locally, creating jobs. This bus is just the start of Egypt's journey to greener, smarter transportation.

lessons.notes:
نقاط هامة على نصوص الاستماع:
My Screen Time
1. Ayman is a 13-year-old student.
2. Ayman spends about three hours a day on his smartphone.
3. He uses social media to chat with his friends.
4. He watches funny videos on the internet.
5. Ayman's mother says he should reduce screen time because it affects his sleep.
6. Ayman thinks that digital devices are great.
The Hybrid Bus
1. Egypt has launched its first hybrid bus in Aswan.
2. The hybrid bus runs on both electricity and diesel.
3. It helps reduce pollution and protects the environment.
4. It supports Egypt's Vision 2030 for clean and smart cities.

الفهم القرائي - Understanding references / vocabulary in context:
- The antonym of "reduce" is "increase".
- The synonym of "support" is "assist".

تعبيرات وحروف جر هامة:

on the phone / tablet (على هاتفك / جهازك اللوحي) | on the screen (على الشاشة) | on the internet (عبر الإنترنت)
at breakfast (في وقت الإفطار) | search for (يبحث عن) | runs on both ... (يعمل باستخدام كلٍّ من ...)
What about + verb-ing? (ماذا عن ...؟) | chat with (يُدردش مع) | (be) made by (يُصنع بواسطة)
balance ... with ... (يوازن ... مع ...) | share with (يشارك مع) | during the day (أثناء اليوم / النهار) | late for ... (متأخر عن ...)

متلازمات لفظية (Collocations):
take breaks (يأخذ فترات راحة) | spend time (يقضي وقت) | create jobs (يوفر فرص عمل) | reduce screen time / pollution (يقلل وقت استخدام الشاشة / التلوث) | share content (يشارك محتوى)

مترادفات ومتضادات (Synonyms and Antonyms):
- amazing (مدهش): synonym wonderful / fantastic - antonym normal / ordinary
- teach (يُعلّم): synonym educate - antonym learn
- connect (يربط): synonym join / link - antonym disconnect
- online (متصل بالإنترنت): synonym connected to the internet - antonym offline
- protect (يحمي): synonym save - antonym harm
- wisely (بحكمة): synonym sensibly - antonym carelessly
- useful (مفيد): synonym helpful - antonym useless / unhelpful
- support (يدعم): synonym assist / help - antonym discourage
- reduce (يقلل): synonym decrease - antonym increase

مقاطع بادئة وناهية (Prefixes & Suffixes):
- digit + -al = digital (تكوّن الصفة من الاسم)
- teach + -ing = teaching (تحوّل الفعل لاسم)
- use + -ful = useful (تحوّل الاسم / الفعل إلى صفة)
- wise + -ly = wisely (تحوّل الصفة إلى ظرف)
- navigate + -ion = navigation / pollute + -ion = pollution (يحوّل الفعل لاسم)
- electric + -ity = electricity (يحوّل الصفة لاسم)

تصريف الأفعال غير المنتظمة:
send - sent - sent (يُرسل) | hurt - hurt - hurt (يؤذي / يؤلم) | spend - spent - spent (يقضي وقت)

Language in Use 1: The Present Simple Tense (زمن المضارع البسيط)
الاستخدام: We use the present simple tense to express facts, habits and daily routine.
1) الجمل المثبتة (Affirmative):
- I / You / We / They + infinitive. ex: We usually play tennis on Fridays.
- He / She / It + infinitive + s / es / ies. ex: Rodina sometimes listens to the radio.
ملاحظات: (s) تضاف مع الفاعل المفرد الغائب: Marwa usually plays tennis on Fridays.
(es) تضاف إذا انتهى الفعل بـ (ss, ch, sh, o, x): My brother often watches TV after lunch.
(ies) تضاف إذا انتهى الفعل بـ (y) مسبوقة بحرف ساكن مع حذف الـ (y): Amal always studies hard for her exams.
2) الجمل المنفية (Negative):
- I / You / We / They + don't + infinitive. ex: I don't get up early on Fridays.
- He / She / It + doesn't + infinitive. ex: She doesn't walk to school.
ملاحظات: يُحذف (s) من الفعل عند النفي بـ (doesn't): He doesn't play football on Thursdays.
عند استخدام (never) في النفي لا يُحذف (s) مع المفرد الغائب: The bus never stops near my house.
3) صيغة الاستفهام (Interrogative):
A) Yes/No question:
- Do + I / you / we / they + infinitive ...? ex: Do you speak English? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
- Does + he / she / it + infinitive ...? ex: Does she cook well? Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
لاحظ حذف حرف (s) من الفعل عند السؤال بـ (Does).
B) Wh-question: Question word + do / does + subject + infinitive ...? ex: What do you study? / Where does she go?

Language in Use 2: Adverbs of Frequency (ظروف التكرار)
always (100%) دائمًا | usually (90%) عادة | often (70%) غالبًا | sometimes (50%) أحيانًا | rarely (10%) نادرًا | never (0%) أبدًا
- Adverbs of frequency with present simple tell us how often something happens. ex: My cousins sometimes send me funny pictures.
- Use adverbs of frequency before the main verb but after (be). ex: He often uses his tablet for homework. / We are never late for school.
- يمكن استخدام بعض ظروف التكرار في بداية الجملة: Sometimes, we go to the club on Sundays.
- للإجابة على سؤال يبدأ بـ How often (كم مرة ...؟): How often + do / does + subject + infinitive ...? ex: How often do you walk to school? - I never walk to school.

Unlock the Exam Trap (فخاخ الامتحان):
Trap 1: Do you use your tablet? (often) -> Do you often use your tablet? (ظرف التكرار قبل الفعل الأساسي)
Trap 2: Ali never plays online games at all. (doesn't) -> Ali doesn't play online games at all. (مع doesn't نحذف s من الفعل)
Trap 3: I use the computer in my science class. (sometimes) -> I sometimes use the computer in my science class.
Trap 4: I usually watch videos on my phone. (How often) -> How often do you watch videos on your phone?

Hidden Points Challenge:
1. Ali is late for school. (never) -> Ali is never late for school.
2. He doesn't come early to school. (comes) -> He never comes early to school.
3. He is always active at school. (lazy) -> He is never lazy at school.

Grammar in points - Rewrite Notes:
1. It's my brother's habit to get up early. (usually) -> My brother usually gets up early. (It's someone's habit = عادة، نحذفها ونستخدم usually ونضيف s للفعل)
2. I sometimes use the computer in my science class. (How often) -> How often do you use the computer in your science class?
3. She doesn't take her phone to school. (never) -> She never takes her phone to school. (never = doesn't، ونضيف s للفعل)
4. I always watch videos on my phone. (habit) -> It's my habit to watch videos on my phone.
5. Ali and Adel play games every day. (What) -> What do Ali and Adel do every day?
6. Salma doesn't speak French at all. (speaks) -> Salma never speaks French.
7. They visit their village from time to time. (sometimes) -> They sometimes visit their village.
8. He's happy all the time. (always) -> He is always happy. (ظرف التكرار بعد v. to be)
9. I go to the club three times a week. (How) -> How often do you go to the club?

- When do you use it? / I use it in the morning before school and in the evening.
- Why do you use it? / I use it to study my lessons, search for information, and chat with my friends.

read.title: Green Cities in Egypt
read.text: Many cities in Egypt are becoming greener and smarter. In Aswan, people now use a hybrid bus that runs on both electricity and diesel. The bus makes less noise and gives out less smoke, so the air in the city is cleaner. Most of its parts are made locally, and this creates new jobs for Egyptian workers. Some schools also try to reduce pollution. Students plant trees in the school yard and turn off the lights when they leave the classroom. Teachers say that small actions can make a big difference for the environment.

listen.title: Digital Devices
listen.text: Hi Talia, how are you? Today I want to tell you about the digital devices I use every day to achieve my tasks. First, I always do my homework on the computer. I use the keyboard to write my assignments. It is used for writing and typing. I also use the mouse to move around the screen and click on things. When I watch videos or listen to music, I use my headphones or speakers. If I want to make a video call with my friends online, I use the webcam. Sometimes, I have to record a presentation for class. That's when I use the microphone. At school, my teacher uses a smartboard to show us pictures, videos, and notes. At the end of the day, I print my homework using the printer. It's super helpful! Write soon and tell me about the digital devices you use. Love, Joury.

lessons.notes:
رسالة Joury إلى Talia - نقاط هامة:
1. Joury uses digital devices every day to achieve her tasks.
2. She uses the keyboard to write her assignments. It is used for writing and typing.
3. She uses the mouse to move around the screen and click on things.
4. She uses headphones or speakers to watch videos or listen to music.
5. She uses the webcam to make a video call with her friends online.
6. She uses the microphone to record a presentation for class.
7. Her teacher uses a smartboard to show pictures, videos, and notes.
8. She prints her homework using the printer at the end of the day.

التعريفات (Study these definitions):
- speakers (سماعات): devices that play sound out loud.
- webcam (كاميرا رقمية): a small camera used for video calls.
- achieve (يحقق / ينجز): successfully bring about or reach by effort.
- email (بريد إلكتروني): a system for sending messages electronically.
- headphones (سماعات الأذن): a device worn on the ears to listen to sound.
- keyboard (لوحة مفاتيح): a device used to type on a computer.
- microphone (ميكروفون): equipment used to record or make sound louder.
- printer (طابعة): a device that prints text or images on paper.

متلازمات لفظية (Collocations):
achieve tasks (ينجز المهام) | record a presentation (يسجل عرضًا تقديميًا) | make a video call (يُجري مكالمة فيديو) | write assignments (يؤدي واجبات / مهام دراسية)

مترادفات ومتضادات (Synonyms and Antonyms):
- ask (يسأل): synonym inquire - antonym answer
- achieve (يحقق / ينجز): synonym accomplish - antonym fail
- important (مهم): synonym necessary - antonym unimportant
- start (يبدأ): synonym begin - antonym finish / end
- send (يرسل): synonym deliver - antonym receive

مقاطع بادئة وناهية (Prefixes & Suffixes):
- -er (تحول الفعل إلى اسم فاعل): record -> recorder, print -> printer, work -> worker
- -ation (تحول الفعل إلى اسم): present -> presentation
- -ment (تحول الفعل إلى اسم): assign -> assignment

تصريف الأفعال غير المنتظمة:
write - wrote - written (يكتب) | tell - told - told (يخبر) | come - came - come (يأتي)

ملاحظات عامة - (Be) used:
(be) used + to + infinitive: The pen is used to write with.
(be) used + for + noun / verb-ing: The keyboard is used for writing and typing.

(ينقر باستخدام الفأرة على ...) | at the end of ... (في نهاية ...) | write soon (اكتب لي قريبًا) | talk online (يتحدث عبر الإنترنت) | It's super helpful! (إنه مفيد للغاية!) | listen to (يستمع إلى) | ready for ... (جاهز لـ ...) | belong to (ينتمي إلى / يخص)

listen.title: My Digital Day (An Email to a Friend)
listen.text: Hi Ayman, how are you? I want to tell you about my digital day. When I get up, I always check my phone. I read messages from my friends and reply to them. Then, I have breakfast while I use my tablet to search for the latest news. At school, teachers usually use a smartboard to help us learn well. We always use computers in the ICT class. After school, I often go online searching for the information for my homework. I always take information from the websites I trust. In the evening, I sometimes play online games with my friends. I never read ebooks on my tablet. I think they are boring. My mother always says, Reading is better than playing online games. What about you? Write back and tell me about your digital day. Yours, Ahmed.

lessons.notes:
رسالة Ahmed إلى Ayman - نقاط هامة:
1. Ahmed always checks his phone when he gets up, reads messages from his friends and replies to them.
2. He has breakfast while he uses his tablet to search for the latest news.
3. At school, teachers usually use a smartboard, and they always use computers in the ICT class.
4. After school, he often goes online to search for information for his homework, and he always takes information from websites he trusts.
5. In the evening, he sometimes plays online games with his friends.
6. He never reads ebooks on his tablet because he thinks they are boring.
7. His mother always says that reading is better than playing online games.

متلازمات لفظية (Collocations):
have breakfast (يتناول الإفطار) | stay safe online (يبقى آمنًا على الإنترنت) | do our best (نبذل قصارى جهدنا) | go online (يتصل بالإنترنت) | design a poster (يصمم ملصقًا) | get a chance (ينال فرصة)

مترادفات ومتضادات:
- correct (صحيح): synonym right - antonym wrong
- boring (ممل): synonym uninteresting - antonym interesting
- simple (بسيط): synonym easy - antonym complex
- respectful (محترم للآخرين): synonym polite - antonym disrespectful / impolite
- trust (يثق): synonym believe - antonym distrust / doubt
- reply (يرد): synonym answer - antonym ask

مقاطع بادئة وناهية:
- perform + -ance = performance (تحول الفعل إلى اسم)
- speak + -er = speaker (تحول الفعل إلى اسم فاعل)
- respect + -ful = respectful (تكوّن صفة من الاسم)
- safe + -ty = safety (تحول الصفة إلى اسم)
- catch + -y = catchy (تحول الفعل إلى صفة)

ملاحظات عامة:
1) webcam - camera
- webcam = كاميرا متصلة بجهاز كمبيوتر أو تليفون: I opened my webcam while chatting with my friend online.
- camera = كاميرا مستقلة لالتقاط الصور: I took some great photos of this view with my camera.
2) devices - apps
- devices = أجهزة / أدوات: Smartboards and smartphones are useful devices.
- apps = تطبيقات أو برامج على الكمبيوتر أو الموبايل لأداء مهام معينة: WhatsApp and Facebook are important apps.

تعبيرات وحروف جر هامة:
write back (يكتب ردًا على) | reply to (يرد على) | try to (يحاول أن) | pass the paper (يمرر الورقة) | in full (بشكل كامل) | at least (على الأقل)

مهارة الكتابة - How to write an email (كيفية كتابة رسالة بريد إلكتروني):
- الإيميل هو الصيغة العصرية للخطاب التقليدي (letter)، ويُستخدم في المراسلات بين الأقارب والأصدقاء عبر الإنترنت.
- To: عنوان البريد الإلكتروني للمُرسَل إليه / From: عنوان البريد الإلكتروني للراسل / Subject: موضوع الرسالة.
- Greeting and name: Dear Sama, / Hello Fatma, / Hi Youssef,
- Introduction (المقدمة): How are you? / I hope you are OK! / I am very happy to send you this email!
- Main part (الجزء الرئيسي): موضوع الرسالة.
- Closing sentence (جملة ختامية): Write back soon! / Write back and tell me about ... / Talk to you later!
- Ending: Yours, / All the best, / Lots of love, ثم التوقيع (signature).

علامات الترقيم - Capital letters (الحروف الكبيرة):
1. At the beginning of a sentence: The sun rises in the east.
2. For proper nouns: Maha, Aswan, Egypt, Africa, Cairo Tower.
3. With days, months and holidays, but not seasons: Monday, April, Christmas.
4. For languages and nationalities: English, Arabic, Spanish, Egyptian.
5. With the pronoun I: Rana and I love to read books.
Practice answers: 1) I went to Alexandria last June. 2) They visited Aswan last January. 3) We learn Arabic, English and French at school.

listen.title: Team-Project Roundtable
listen.text: Today, our class has a team project roundtable. Our teacher gives every team a chance to share ideas. First, we listen to our classmates, and we are always respectful. Then, each team designs a colorful poster with a slogan to help students stay safe online. We add tips like Never share your password and Always ask an adult for help. We print the poster on paper, and we follow the rules of the project. I think this is a great chance to do our best and work together.

read.title: A Poster for Online Safety
read.text: Last week, the students of Class 1/3 had a team project. Each team designed a colorful poster about staying safe online. Nada's team wrote a short slogan: Think before you click! They added tips such as Never share your password and Ask an adult for help. Every member had a chance to speak during the roundtable, and the team members were respectful of each other's ideas. At the end, the teacher put the posters on the noticeboard, and everyone said that Nada's team did their best.
